title: MiniMax H3 Seed Hunter v2.5
source: Converted from the agent_workflows_nonAPI stage exports with app.ue_modified_prompt() in the 8188 frontend (2026-10-25). Prompts and reference files are stripped.

chains.handoff: The picked mp3 becomes <Audio 1>; set duration_s to its length.
Same params and seed; take=k re-renders that take, then upscales it.
The final mp4 becomes <Video 1>. Upscale parts separately before combining.

stages.title: Extend a video - native audio
stages.does: Continues <Video 1> from its last frames and stitches the new part on.
rules: No upscale: extended clips can't be upscaled. Upscale each part separately, then combine.

params.label: Prompt
params.description: H3 prompt in this stage's format; see PROMPTING.md in the pack.

params.name: references
params.label: Reference media
params.description: <Video 1> = the clip to continue (24 fps, same aspect ratio)

params.name: duration_s
params.label: Duration (seconds)
params.description: Snapped to 17n+5 frames at 24 fps. With your audio, match its length. For an extension this is the new part only.

stages.title: Extend a video - upscaled new part - native audio
stages.does: Continues <Video 1> at 0.4 MP, upscales only the new part to ~2 MP and 48 fps, and saves it on its own (no stitch).
outputs: new part only (~1088x1952, 48 fps); join it after <Video 1>
stages.timing: About 10 minutes for an 8 s part (first pass ~6 min, upscale ~4 min; measured 2026-10-28).
rules: The output is the new part only. Join it after the clip you continued.
One upscale per run.
Built by scripts/build_extend_upscale_recipe.py from the extend and upscale recipes, not from a UI export.
